item.label: Posts For Current Page
item.description: Display posts for the current page. Useful on archive and index pages.

item.label: Related Post
item.description: Display related posts for single post. This will only work for single post.

item.label: Post Count
item.description: Choose how much posts you would like to display per page.

item.label: Post Offset Number
item.description: Choose how many posts you would like to skip. These posts will not be shown in the feed.
